title: 第3079章 姜尘VS凤八第3078章 江流VS姜望二
content_zh:
“砰！”
姜尘把手中的灭天令一甩，在把凤八给逼退之后，朝着远处江流和战斗的看了一眼。
因为，此时的姜家族人想要获胜，可就只能看姜望那里了。
可是，当他看到江流和姜望的战斗情况后，脸上神情顿时显得有些不好起来。
虽然他并不是修炼的死亡法则本源之力，并不知道死亡法则之力的威势，究竟有多强。
但是，作为主神的威势，姜尘他却是知道的。
因为他可是真的跟姜望动过手，那可是连一招都没接到，就已经一败涂地。
而且，姜尘明显地感觉得到，当时姜望对他出手，根本就没有当回事。
因此，在他之前的感觉里面，一直都有着无敌之姿的姜望，哪怕现在是面对另外一个主神，也应该能够战而胜之。
但是，现在姜尘看到姜望跟江流对战的情况，却是有些不太相信眼前发生的。
因为，他明显地看得出来，那江流对姜望出手的情况，跟当初姜望对他出手的时候，情况似乎是一样的。
这说明什么？
说明江流在跟姜望对战的时候，似乎是跟玩一样，根本就没有出尽全力。
从这里就可以看得出来，那江流的战力，比姜望高了起码一筹有多。
对于主神的威势，只在姜望身上感受过的姜尘来说，他并不清楚，那些主神之间的战力是如何划分。
但是，他却是知道，眼前的局势恐怕对姜望，还有姜家不是太好啊！
只是，还不容得他多想，凤八就已经再次朝他攻了上来。
而且，这次就连身在远处的帝天，也是在迅速地朝他这里而来。
“轰隆隆！”
姜尘根本作不出其他想法，就重新跟凤八战在了一起。

原本就带着想要好好表现心里的凤八，之前就一直在拼命。
现在看到战斗局势在朝着他们这边倾斜，战斗起来比起之前还要拼命。
因为，此次如果战胜了姜家，那他们凤凰一族的罪责，就有可能会被主神大人给赦免。
而且这对于他们凤凰一族来说，很有可能是他们唯一一次，赦罪的机会。
因此，无论是凤八，还是其他凤凰一族人，在开战伊始，就一直在出尽全力拼命。
这也是姜氏子弟在刚一开战的时候，就出现大量伤亡的主要原因。
“风八！你和你们凤凰一族，没必要这么拼命吧！”
“你也不看看，你凤凰一族现在已经死了多少人，你也不想自己战到最后，所有战利品都被其他人得了吧！”
姜尘一边应对凤八的攻击，一边想要以语言让凤八，还有凤凰一族放放水，不要那么拼命。
毕竟，像他们这样出尽全力战斗，可是给凤凰一族和姜家，都带来了大量的伤亡。
虽然，其他种族生灵也同样出力战斗，却是始终在收着一些力量，在预防着随时会出现的意外。
哪里像凤凰一族这般，仿似他们姜家跟凤凰一族，有着什么深仇大恨一般，就是一心想着把他们给弄死。
只是，面对姜尘的挑拨，凤八根本就不作理会。
“凤舞九天，燎原！”
甚至，在凤八的身上，突然有着赤红色光芒闪烁，然后一道道火焰，从他的身上爆发出来，迅速地朝着姜尘覆盖过去。
“你疯了？竟然动用本源真火？”
感应到凤八身上的气势突然大涨，并且有着火焰冒了出来，姜尘那原本还显得平静的脸色终于大变。
虽然他并不明白，这凤八怎么会突然要跟拼命，却也是不得不全力应对了。
content_en:
"Bang!"
Jiang Chen flicked the Heaven-Destroying Order in his hand, and after forcing Feng Ba back, he glanced at Jiang Liu and Zhan in the distance.
Because if the Jiang family wanted to win at this time, they could only look to Jiang Wang.
However, when he saw the fighting situation between Jiang Liu and Jiang Wang, his expression suddenly looked a little bad.
Although he is not cultivating the original power of the Law of Death, he does not know how powerful the power of the Law of Death is.
However, Jiang Chen knew the power of the Lord God.
Because he actually fought against Jiang Wang, but he was completely defeated without even receiving a single move.
Moreover, Jiang Chen could clearly feel that Jiang Wang didn't take it seriously at all when he attacked him.
Therefore, in his previous feelings, Jiang Wang, who had always been invincible, should be able to win even if he faced another Lord God now.
However, now that Jiang Chen saw Jiang Wang and Jiang Liu fighting, he couldn't believe what was happening in front of him.
Because, he could clearly see that the situation when Jiang Liu took action against Jiang Wang seemed to be the same as when Jiang Wang took action against him.
What does this mean?
This shows that when Jiang Liu fought against Jiang Wang, he seemed to be playing for fun and did not try his best at all.
It can be seen from here that Jiang Liu's combat power is at least one step higher than Jiang Wang's.
For Jiang Chen, who had only experienced the power of the Lord Gods from Jiang Wang, he did not know how the combat power of the Lord Gods was divided.
However, he knew that the situation in front of him might not be good for Jiang Wang and the Jiang family!
However, before he could think too much, Feng Ba had already attacked him again.
Moreover, this time even Di Tian, ​​who was far away, was quickly coming towards him.
"Boom!"
Jiang Chen couldn't think of any other ideas at all, so he fought with Feng Ba again.
Feng Ba, who originally wanted to express his feelings well, had been working hard before.
Now they see that the battle situation is tilting towards their side, and they are fighting even more desperately than before.
Because, if they defeat the Jiang family this time, their Phoenix family's sins may be forgiven by the Lord God.
And for the Phoenix clan, this is likely to be their only chance to forgive their sins.
Therefore, whether it is Feng Ba or other members of the Phoenix clan, they have been trying their best since the beginning of the war.
This was also the main reason why the Jiang family suffered a large number of casualties when the war first started.
"Feng Ba! You and your Phoenix clan don't have to fight so hard!"
"You don't even want to look at how many people in your Phoenix clan have died. You don't want to fight until the end and all the spoils will be taken by others!"
While Jiang Chen was dealing with Feng Ba's attack, he wanted to use words to make Feng Ba and the Phoenix clan relax and not be so desperate.
After all, fighting like them with all their strength brought a lot of casualties to both the Phoenix clan and the Jiang family.
Although the creatures of other races are also fighting hard, they are always holding back some strength to prevent accidents that may occur at any time.
It's not like the Phoenix Clan. It's as if the Jiang family and the Phoenix Clan have some kind of deep hatred, and they just want to kill them.
However, in the face of Jiang Chen's provocation, Feng Ba ignored it at all.
"The phoenix dances for nine days, starting a prairie fire!"
Even, on Feng Ba's body, a crimson light suddenly flickered, and then a stream of flames burst out from his body and quickly covered Jiang Chen.
"Are you crazy? You actually used the true fire?"
Sensing that Feng Ba's aura suddenly surged and flames emerged, Jiang Chen's originally calm expression finally changed.
Although he didn't understand why Feng Ba suddenlyHe had to fight tooth and nail, but he had to deal with it with all his strength.
